description: Public Print::validate interaction contracts for belt incompatibilities, sequential feature gates, and classic wipe-tower addressing.

mutants.description: A one-layer raft is incompatible with belt mode; raising the threshold would incorrectly accept the exact invalid interaction while the zero-raft control remains valid.
Clumping detection is rejected only for multi-object by-object printing; the disabled control must remain valid and the enabled case must report enable_wrapping_detection.
Ooze prevention is incompatible only with single-extruder multi-material wipe-tower mode; enabling ooze prevention alone must remain valid.
